name: ludock
description: A self-hosted control panel for existing Docker game servers

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ludock/shared build && pnpm --filter @ludock/backend build && pnpm --filter @ludock/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ludock/shared build && pnpm --filter @ludock/backend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @ludock/backend exec tsc -p tsconfig.typechecks.json && pnpm --filter @ludock/frontend exec tsc -b
scripts.test: node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @ludock/shared build && pnpm --filter @ludock/backend test && pnpm --filter @ludock/frontend test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
